title: Four Percent
summary: KC practices a consenting shot, follows a charging lead and preserves the full wedding recording. His earlier crop omitted a person helping someone; he can admit that now or leave a clearly recorded conversation for later.

stages.title: Four percent. Forty thousand opinions.
stages.text:
KC: Forty thousand viewers. Four percent battery. Both numbers are fictional until I can charge.
Roommate: Your ring light has been a ring for two days.

The story phone starts at 4%. Reading, panning, pausing and closing the game spend nothing. Each saved take costs 1%. If it runs out, borrow enough charge and retry for free.
stages.summary: Story battery starts at 4%. Only a saved take spends 1%. Depletion has a free charging recovery; original footage is never lost.

stages.title: An audience is not a permission slip
stages.text:
KC: Can you be in a practice shot?
Roommate: This practice, yes. Do not turn my breakfast into a series.
KC: Limited breakfast rights. Understood.

Keep the agreed practice private. The illustrated story camera does not use your device camera or upload a recording.
stages.summary: The roommate agrees to a private practice shot. Ask first and keep it within that agreement.

choices.label: Treat the agreement as permission to broadcast anything
choices.hint: The agreement covers this private practice. It does not cover an unrestricted broadcast.

stages.title: Frame it before you explain it
stages.text:
Roommate: Can the window be in focus? It has supported this household for years.

Use Pan left/right and Wide to include all three labelled subjects together. The centred wide frame keeps the context. Save a take for 1% story battery, or use Guided full frame at the same cost. Each attempt to save a take costs 1%; adjusting the frame costs nothing. Empty battery offers free charge.
stages.summary: Centre the camera and select Wide, then save a take for 1%. Guided full frame has the same cost and progress. Empty battery offers Borrow enough charge.

stages.title: Three ways to find a socket
stages.text:
KC: My content has reach. My cable has not.

Choose a charging lead. Each lead has a way forward; none removes footage or money.
stages.summary: Try the kiosk, a friend's power bank or the community charging bench. All routes rejoin with a cable and a fair turn.

choices.label: Ask a friend about a power bank
Go to the community charging bench

kiosk.text:
The kiosk shutter is down. Its sign points to the community bench.
KC: Even the closed shop has better directions than my followers.
A neighbour offers a spare cable for the bench.
kiosk.summary: The closed kiosk's sign points to the community bench; a neighbour offers a spare cable.

bank.text:
Friend: The power bank is empty. The cable still has ambition. Borrow it.
KC: A device with my exact business plan.
The friend points to the community charging bench.
bank.summary: The empty power bank cannot charge the phone, but its owner lends a cable and points to the community bench.

bench.text:
Attendant: One socket, one queue. We can fit your phone after this one.
KC: Finally, a platform with a clear algorithm.
A neighbour offers a spare cable.
bench.summary: The community bench has a clear queue and a spare cable for KC's turn.

stages.title: A cable and a fair turn
stages.text: Ask to borrow the cable and wait for the agreed turn. This scene uses no StreetCoins or real payment.
stages.summary: Borrow the cable with permission and wait for the agreed turn.

choices.label: Borrow the offered cable and wait for the turn
Push past the queue with the phone
choices.hint: The offered cable and a fair turn both get you through. Wait for the agreed place in the queue.

stages.title: Enough charge. No miracle required.
stages.text:
Attendant: You have enough for the copy.
KC: Please tell my sponsors that sentence.

Top up the story phone to 4%. The next take costs 1%.
stages.summary: The borrowed cable tops the story phone up to 4%, enough to preserve the original. Later depletion still has free recovery.

choices.label: Take the agreed charge and thank the neighbour

stages.title: The bit outside the headline
stages.text:
The cropped edit makes Nneka appear to leave alone with the bag. The wider original also shows her turning to help Bisi.
KC: That is a very inconvenient extra half of the frame.

Compare the crop and original before deciding what the scene can support. Keep this private; witness permission for any later broadcast still matters.
stages.summary: The original contains context missing from the crop: Nneka helps Bisi. Review the full private source before making a claim.

records.title: Earlier crop
lines: A complete sequence is not established

records.title: Original private recording
lines: MC and service-exit sign remain visible
The family still needs timing and witness accounts

choices.label: Compare the full source before making a claim
Keep only the crop because the headline is simpler
choices.hint: The helping action is missing from that crop. Compare the full source and keep the claim within what it shows.

stages.title: Keep the context in the copy
stages.text:
KC: The original is not an apology, but it is where one should start.

In this illustrated review window, include MC, service-exit sign and helping action together. Centre the frame and use Wide; saving the private full-frame copy costs 1% story battery. This is a review of an existing story recording, not a new recording or a broadcast.
stages.summary: Keep all three context labels in the centred wide copy for 1%. Guided full frame is equivalent. The copy stays private; evidence is awarded once when the chapter finishes.

stages.title: The original gets the first slot
stages.text:
A sponsor draft asks for an intro. The private original is waiting to be preserved.
KC: For once, the backup can have top billing.

Keep the original first. The sponsor draft can wait without blocking the story.
stages.summary: Preserve the original before spending attention on the sponsor intro. No upload is performed.

choices.label: Replace the original with the sponsor draft
choices.hint: Keep the original source. A sponsor draft does not replace the context the family needs.

stages.title: A correction needs a beginning
stages.text: KC can tell Ngozi that his earlier crop omitted the helping action, or say he still needs to check it. Both choices continue. Waiting leaves an unresolved conversation, with an opportunity to repair it later; it does not delete the original or lock a main mission.
stages.summary: Admit the earlier crop now, or record that the conversation is still unresolved. Both routes retain the evidence and all main missions.

choices.label: Tell Ngozi the earlier crop left out the helping action
Say I still need to check it; keep the conversation unresolved

stages.title: Content is loading. So is lunch.
stages.text:
Ngozi: Come to the canteen.
KC: For food or questioning?
Ngozi: We discussed this. Wash your hands.

The full private source is preserved and the disclosure choice is recorded. Family Meeting is next.
stages.summary: KC secured a cable and the private original. The earlier crop omitted context; the disclosure choice remains saved. The three leads will compare their evidence at Family Meeting.

choices.label: Save the original and head to the canteen
